limits: No art-conformity, FPS, offline-install or complete-E2E claim.
Scene waits use existing native120s renderer and45s pending limits; they are not the original focused15s gates.
Three real scenes are built sequentially: new run, saved Reprendre, direct initial-save entry. Welcome mobile/failure cases remain preview-only.
Ordinary /mandats/ with local save intentionally shows Reprendre and loads the poster. The direct-save check is precisely the supported zero-decision #challenge.
After adoption the preserved map host may retain a hidden image node. Visual absence is asserted; direct entry asserts no image node and no poster request.
The expected PNG503 is recorded separately; no other HTTP failure or page error is accepted. All actual console messages remain in evidence.
No Scene/camera API, game-state injection, new test/config/timeout/assertion change, production edit or external send.
